register_dataset_operator: use Dataset.register_op to create a decorator that registers a new dataset transformation operator as a method
register_dataset_source: use Dataset.register_src to create a decorator that registers a data source factory as a from_name method
register_package_modules: use Dataset.register_package to auto-discover and import all modules from specified subpackages
create_dataset_subclass: subclass Dataset and implement reset and __next__ methods to build a custom iterable dataset
iterate_dataset: use the Dataset __iter__ method to iterate over dataset items via the __next__ implementation
